title: LMD compliance rule
description: One entry in packages/rules/lmd_rules.v1.json. Every condition/applicable_when string must be a normalize()+compile_condition()-loadable DSL expression -- see backend/lmd/dsl/. This schema validates rule metadata shape only; it cannot validate DSL syntax, which is enforced at load time by backend/lmd/engine/loader.py (a rule file that fails the DSL whitelist refuses to load, per CLAUDE.md invariant 3).

rule_id.description: e.g. LM-C01, LM-M04a. Must be unique within the file.

confidence_policy.description: structural rules bypass the min_field_confidence gate entirely (CLAUDE.md invariant 5).

citation_verified.description: false renders the citation greyed and tagged 'illustrative' in the UI (CLAUDE.md invariant 10).

exempt_from_effective_gate.description: Only true for LM-T01, whose own job is to test the ruleset's effective window -- see its _fixture_notes.

_fixture_notes.description: Free-text audit trail for a deliberate correction made when porting from research/NotebookLM/rule_engine.py. Not read by the loader.
